STREET

BORN & BRED.

STI West Street Camp is a powerhouse dance company rooted in street culture, passion, and artistic excellence. We bring energy, creativity, and professionalism to every performance — from intimate gigs to massive productions.

With 60 trained and experienced dancers, we match the perfect ensemble to your event's vision, scale, and vibe. No event too big, no detail too small.

What We Offer

OUR
SERVICES

🎂
Birthday Gigs

Surprise the celebrant with a full-choreographed performance. We customize routines to match the theme, music, and energy you want.

📣
Brand Promotions

Make your product launch unforgettable. High-energy routines that draw crowds and create serious buzz around your brand.

🎬
Event Production

Full production — choreography, staging, costumes, and direction. We handle the creative so you can focus on your event.

🎪
Flash Mobs

Turn any location into a stage. Seamless, shocking, and viral-worthy. Perfect for proposals, campaigns, and public surprises.

🏢
Corporate Events

From team-building to annual galas, we add the wow factor with polished performances tailored to your company culture.

🌟
Concerts & Shows

Need backup dancers or a full ensemble? Our 60-member roster has the talent and discipline to deliver at any scale.
